panels.title: p99 latency (dashed: 50 ms SLO)
panels.description: Measured by the load tester from each request's scheduled send time, so queueing in an overloaded system is included (no coordinated omission). Requests that were never sent because their 1 s deadline passed are not in this panel; see Availability.

panels.title: Requests per second (solid: 2xx, dashed: target)
panels.description: Solid: successful responses per second (30 s rate). Dashed: the scheduled rate. When solid falls below dashed, the app is saturated. Cross-checked against packets on the app pod's network interface (validation.md).

panels.title: CPU usage (% of 2-CPU limit, 3m avg, ±5%)
panels.description: cAdvisor sample timestamps lag the real measurement by 10-15 s, so short windows over- and under-read. A 3-minute window keeps the error within about ±5%; readings slightly above 100% are this sampling error, since the CFS quota cannot be exceeded. Use CPU throttling to see exactly when the limit is hit.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (framework) (label_replace(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="bench", container="app"}[3m]), "framework", "$1", "pod", "(.+)-[a-z0-9]{6,10}-[a-z0-9]{5}")) / sum by (framework) (label_replace(container_spec_cpu_quota{namespace="bench", container="app"} / container_spec_cpu_period{namespace="bench", container="app"}, "framework", "$1", "pod", "(.+)-[a-z0-9]{6,10}-[a-z0-9]{5}"))

panels.title: Memory usage (% of 256 MiB limit)
panels.description: Working set memory divided by the container memory limit. Matches the GKE system metric kubernetes_io:container_memory_used_bytes.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (framework) (label_replace(container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="bench", container="app"}, "framework", "$1", "pod", "(.+)-[a-z0-9]{6,10}-[a-z0-9]{5}")) / sum by (framework) (label_replace(container_spec_memory_limit_bytes{namespace="bench", container="app"}, "framework", "$1", "pod", "(.+)-[a-z0-9]{6,10}-[a-z0-9]{5}"))

panels.title: Availability (2xx within 1 s deadline, % of scheduled)
panels.description: Share of scheduled requests that got a 2xx response within 1 s of their scheduled time. The denominator counts every scheduled request: sent (any outcome) plus dropped (not sent because the deadline passed while every connection was busy).

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (framework) (rate(tester_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="bench", run!="", status=~"2..", le="1"}[30s])) / (sum by (framework) (rate(tester_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="bench", run!=""}[30s])) + sum by (framework) (rate(tester_dropped_requests_total{namespace="bench", run!=""}[30s])))

panels.title: CPU throttling (% of CFS periods)
panels.description: Share of 100 ms CFS periods in which the app used up its 2-CPU quota and was paused. A ratio of two counters read together, so the cAdvisor timestamp lag cancels out; it rises exactly where the app saturates.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (framework) (label_replace(rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace="bench", container="app"}[1m]), "framework", "$1", "pod", "(.+)-[a-z0-9]{6,10}-[a-z0-9]{5}")) / sum by (framework) (label_replace(rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace="bench", container="app"}[1m]), "framework", "$1", "pod", "(.+)-[a-z0-9]{6,10}-[a-z0-9]{5}"))
